title: Start with products
text: Start with Browse products on the home page.

title: Find a brand or model
text: Search a brand or model, then narrow the results by product type.

title: Narrow your search
text: Open More filters for region, currency, and photo coverage.

title: Choose up to four
text: Check the size, colour, photographs, and dated price on each product. Tick Compare this offer to save your choices. You can select up to four.

title: Review and export
text: Review your shortlist side by side, and export a CSV or a comparison with photos.

title: Follow news and updates
text: For launches and catalogue changes, open News and updates.

title: Explore the research
text: For research, open Insights. Sales and analysis shows saved sales signals and prices. Target inspiration shows product directions, proposed concepts, and supporting competitor products.

title: Return home anytime
text: Use Home to return to the starting page, and Help and guide to replay this walkthrough.
